name: Run Ortigas 2026
short_description: Run Ortigas 2026 is on Sunday 15 November 2026 at Ortigas East in Pasig, over 1 km, 5 km, 10 km and 21.1 km.
ai_summary: Run Ortigas 2026 is a RunRio road race through the streets of Ortigas East in Pasig City. It offers 21 km, 10 km and 5 km races, plus a 1 km dog category. All categories start beside Tiendesitas on Retail Road, and the Race Roster event page lists a 3:00 AM event time.

faqs.question: What are the age limits at Run Ortigas 2026?
faqs.answer: The race mechanics set the 21K minimum age at 18 and the 10K minimum at 13. The 5K and the 1K are open to runners aged 5 and above, and entrants under 18 need a parent or guardian to sign the entry form.

faqs.question: Is there a cut-off time at Run Ortigas 2026?
faqs.answer: All categories must start within 15 minutes of their gun start. To reopen the roads to traffic, an ambulance picks up remaining runners on the course from 7:00 AM, and those runners are disqualified.
